findings.fixHint: Add class="clip" to the element so Studio and the linter can recognise it as a clip.

findings.message: <video id="short-problem-video"> has data-start="3" inside a sub-composition. Nested media timing is local to its composition by default; a nonzero value can be confused with a legacy root-global timestamp.
findings.fixHint: Keep data-start="3" if it is composition-local. If this is a legacy root-global timestamp, add data-hf-media-start-basis="global"; otherwise convert it to local time by subtracting the host start.
